The lightning‑fast M4 chip with 50 per cent more unified system memory elevates performance for all the things you love to do on iPad Air. It’s an AI powerhouse, enabling the AI features and capabilities you use every day to get things done faster, effortlessly. And the GPU architecture delivers even more fluid advanced graphics whether you’re working, streaming, creating or gaming. All with amazing efficiency for all‑day battery life. 4 Up to 2.3x faster than iPad Air with M1 5 Over 4x faster 3D pro rendering with ray tracing than iPad Air with M1 6 Discover what you can do with the power of M4 All kinds of powerful. The M4 chip features an 8‑core CPU with 3 performance cores and 5 efficiency cores that power all types of creative tasks, like blazing‑fast photo compositing in Photoshop. And its 9‑core GPU delivers up to 60% faster graphics performance than M1 for fast, fluid 3D CAD or video editing. And with 12GB of on‑device unified system memory, it delivers faster load times, smooth multi­tasking and amazingly responsive gaming. M4 also enables hardware-accelerated ray tracing, so light, shadows and reflections in apps and games look incredibly vibrant and realistic. Advanced Neural Engine for advanced AI apps. 3x faster Neural Engine performance than M1 The 16‑core Neural Engine in M4 makes iPad Air an even more powerful device for AI. More unified system memory and higher memory bandwidth speed up everyday AI tasks like searching for text in Goodnotes. The Neural Engine also enables powerful AI features in photo and video editing apps, giving you greater control and helping you bring your creative vision to life effortlessly. Close iPadOS and apps. Using recycled materials, like 100% recycled cobalt in the battery, reduces the need to mine new material, which avoids the carbon emissions and environmental impacts of mining. Learn more in our Product En­viron­men­tal Report (PDF) How you can help. You can protect the earth’s precious resources by trading in, passing on or recycling devices and accessories you no longer use. You can take them to any Apple Store for free, secure recycling. We also offer other ways to recycle, including options by post. Learn how to trade in or recycle devices Manufactured with 40% renewable electricity. Renewable Electricity Our approach. Using electricity from renewable sources like wind and solar across our global supply chain - instead of fossil fuels - significantly reduces carbon emissions from manufacturing Apple products. Learn more in our Product En­viron­men­tal Report (PDF) How you can help. You can extend the lifespan of your batteries and Apple products by using Optimised Battery Char­ging. It works by learning your charging habits and delaying the final charge — from 80% to 100% — until you are likely to need it. Testing consisted of full battery discharge while performing each of the following tasks: video playback and internet browsing using Wi‑Fi or a mobile data network (cellular models subscribed to LTE and 5G networks). Video content was a repeated 2-hour 23-minute movie purchased from the iTunes Store. Internet over Wi‑Fi and a mobile data network tested by browsing 20 popular web pages. All settings were default except: Wi‑Fi was associated with a network (except for internet browsing over mobile data network); the Wi‑Fi feature Ask to Join Networks and Auto-Brightness were turned off; Brightness was set to 50%; and WPA2 encryption was enabled. Battery life depends on device settings, usage, network and many other factors. Battery tests are conducted using specific iPad units; actual results may vary.
